timestamp_note: Exact measurement start and end instants were not recorded. They are unknown and must not be inferred from server Date headers.

protocols.new_connection: One fresh curl process per request; 0.6 second sleep after each completed request.
protocols.persistent_http2: One curl process and reusable HTTP/2 connection; request starts limited by --rate 1/s.
protocols.redirect_download: One fresh curl process with --location per archive; API HTTP 303 followed to s3.pgkb.org; 0.6 second sleep after each completed request.
